title: Sparse Poison, Strong Hijack: Efficient Trajectory-Level Backdoors in Vision-Language-Action Models with Only 1\% Poisoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.32304v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models advance robotic manipulation, but their reliance on demonstrations exposes them to backdoor threats. Among these threats, trajectory-level targeted backdoors are particularly challenging and may pose greater safety risks than behavior-disrupting attacks: rather than merely causing task failures or local action deviations, they must sustain closed-loop redirection to complete an attacker-specified multi-step task. To reliably induce such behaviors, existing methods typically rely on high poisoning rates to obtain sufficient target-trajectory supervision. However, high poisoning rates may compromise clean-task performance, whereas low rates leave target-trajectory supervision scarce and backdoor learning vulnerable to interference from dominant clean-task updates. To resolve this trade-off at low poisoning rates, we propose a two-stage co-optimization framework guided by vision, language, and action. Sta

translated_title: 稀疏毒化，强力劫持：仅需1%毒化率即可在视觉-语言-动作模型中实现高效的轨迹级后门攻击
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型推动了机器人操作技术的发展，但其对演示数据的依赖使其面临后门威胁。在这些威胁中，轨迹级定向后门攻击尤其具有挑战性，且可能比破坏行为的攻击带来更大的安全风险：这类攻击不仅仅是导致任务失败或局部动作偏差，而是必须维持闭环重定向以完成攻击者指定的多步骤任务。为了可靠地诱导此类行为，现有方法通常依赖较高的毒化率来获取足够的目标轨迹监督。然而，高毒化率可能会损害干净任务的性能，而低毒化率则会导致目标轨迹监督稀缺，使后门学习容易受到占主导地位的干净任务更新的干扰。为了在低毒化率下解决这一权衡问题，我们提出了一种由视觉、语言和动作共同引导的两阶段协同优化框架……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种由视觉、语言和动作共同引导的两阶段协同优化框架，仅需1%的毒化率即可在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中有效植入轨迹级后门攻击，解决了低毒化率下后门学习与干净任务性能之间的权衡难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage co-optimization framework guided by vision, language, and action that enables efficient trajectory-level backdoor attacks in Vision-Language-Action models with only 1% poisoning, resolving the trade-off between scarce backdoor supervision and clean-task performance at low poisoning rates.
